<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/plugins/{id}/data"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Drops every table under the plugin's prefix and clears its key/value state, settings and secrets, migration ledger and files. Role permissions stay, and the capabilities the admin agreed to are granted again. The plugin stays installed but is switched off, so nothing is writing while its tables go. It cannot be undone.
